summary: Final re-fire to confirm the residual blocking finding from the prior technical instance is resolved. That finding: line 109's 'What happened' recap read 'the agent asked one question at a time,' contradicting the prompt's actual 'three questions at a time' mechanism, which the earlier fix pass had already corrected at lines 7, 59, and 67 but missed at line 109. Independently re-verified against the current file (expanded via scripts/expand-md.js, which passes through unchanged — still no {{prompt:}} markers): line 109 now reads 'the agent asked three questions at a time, walking down branches you didn't think to check, suggesting answers,' consistent with lines 7 ('A second-pass walk-down, three questions at a time'), 59 ('walk down every unresolved branch of the plan three questions at a time'), and 67 ('The second read asks three questions at a time'). All four occurrences now agree with push-back-on-the-plan-2's fenced instruction ('Ask me three questions at a time... I'll confirm or correct three at a time'). Cross-checked against git: `git diff HEAD -- curriculum/exercises/push-back-on-the-plan.md` shows the working-tree diff is exactly the fix pass already audited in the prior instance (cadence corrections, citation labels, source-verification block, Quality line) plus this one additional line-109 cadence fix — no other content drifted. Re-sampled all 4 cited URLs live today (2026-07-26): all return HTTP 200 (code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md, github.com/mattpocock/skills @62f43a1, every.to/source-code/compound-engineering-the-definitive-guide, rogermartin.medium.com/what-would-have-to-be-true). With the sole blocking finding resolved, this file now carries zero blocking technical findings. Four non-blocking todos persist unchanged from the prior audit (none newly surfaced, none resolved by this fix): the 'keep planning with feedback' vs. live UI copy 'No, keep planning' precision gap (already self-documented as a CAVEAT with fallback in the file's own source-verification block), missing action lead-in on the optional unfiltered-Pocock prompt, no 'No preamble' suppressor/skim-past primer on either plan-mode prompt, and no progress-streaming instruction in the 8-12-minute plan-mode fence. No skill references, no zombie stats, no dead links, no missing source-type labels.
